dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: Welcome, dear guest. Welcome to the Outlander Affairs Agency.

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: You can sign up here to set up a fan work booth at the Irodori Festival, and guests may also certify their family members to arrange for their food and board.

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: Of course, the usual store and residency permits will still be processed as always.

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: Also... Don't forget about the handling fee.

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: Hello, traveler from afar. Welcome to Inazuma. You may apply for a Resident Permit here.

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: Also... Don't forget about the handling fee.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Residence Permit?

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: According to the Sakoku Decree currently in effect, foreign visitors must apply for a Residence Permit if they wish to stay on Ritou for a long period of time.

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: Please get your Entry Permit prepared before applying for the Residence Permit... as well as the other necessary "materials."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Handling fee?

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: Of course. If you need to get something done, a handling fee is necessary.

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: As for how much it is going to be... It depends on your reason for staying in Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: The more urgent and more important the matter is, the more attention the Outlander Affairs Agency will pay. But of course, the required fee had best match that level of urgency, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye...

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: Take care. Please come back when you have prepared the required "materials."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Handling fee?

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: Of course. If you need to get something done, a handling fee is necessary.

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: 500 Mora per visitor.

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: Hmm, is that very little? ...Oh, this is the first time I've seen people complaining about the low prices.

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: But this is indeed the official fee. If you don't believe me, please check the latest regulations issued by the Kanjou Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: Hello, traveler from afar. Welcome to Inazuma. You may apply for an Entry Permit here.

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: Also... Don't forget about the handling fee.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Entry Permit?

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: According to our current regulations, foreign merchants must apply for an Entry Permit if they wish to stay and do business in Ritou for a long period.

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: As such, please get your identification papers prepared before moving forward with these procedures... as well as the other necessary "materials."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Handling fee?

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: Of course. If you need to get something done, a handling fee is necessary.

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: It will be 500 Mora per visitor.

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: Hmm, is that very little? ...Oh, this is the first time I've seen anyone complaining about the low prices, despite the large number of people arriving to set up shop here.

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: But this is indeed the official fee. If you don't believe me, please check the latest regulations issued by the Kanjou Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Yurika
dialogues.text: Take care. Please come back when you have prepared the required "materials."
